title: Buildings & building services
introen: Monitor selected SPDs in building distribution and services, from incoming boards to rooftop equipment. Condition information helps the facilities team identify protective devices requiring inspection or replacement at the relevant electrical protection point.

scenes.en: Monitor the SPDs installed at the building’s incoming distribution board. Condition information helps the facilities team identify a protective device requiring attention at this central electrical protection point. Relate the indication to the relevant board and arrange inspection or replacement through the building’s maintenance process.
